problems.should_be: まわ.り (unhyphenated), which is absent from this kanji's readings list
problems.why: The span まわ and the okurigana り are both right, so the sound taught is correct; the slot's POSITION is not. A leading hyphen marks the form used when the kanji is NOT word-initial (遠回り, 身の回り). 回り/まわり is a standalone noun, word-initial. KANJIDIC2 lists both まわ.り and -まわ.り for 回, but this entry only carries -まわ.り, so the aligner had no correct slot to choose. The corpus note on that slot still reads 'Variante 回り marcada com hífen para o fim de palavras compostas. Nenhum composto desta entrada foi agrupado nela.' — which now contradicts the compound sitting in it. Note the aligner does get the analogous 通 case right (通り/とおり -> とお.り, 通り/どおり -> -どお.り) precisely because 通 has both slots. Pre-alignment file had 回り under まわ.る, which is also wrong (the word writes り, not る), so this is not a regression.

This is a single kanji, so it cannot be 熟字訓, and the entry already carries the on reading メエトル — KANJIDIC2's archaic transcription of メートル — with zero compounds. The word is the abbreviation of 米突/メートル, and 米 alone genuinely reads メートル in measurement contexts, so it does have a reading-by-reading account. The alignment failed only on the orthographic difference メエトル vs メートル (エ vs the chouon mark). Grouping it under メエトル would teach nothing false. 亜米利加/アメリカ next to it is real ateji and is correctly left in irregular.

checked_and_correct_notes: 洗: あら covers 洗う/お手洗い/手洗い; セン covers 洗濯・洗剤・洗面・水洗 (水すい+洗せん). All sound-accounted.
兄: 兄弟/きょうだい correctly under キョウ (弟 takes the rendaku だい). お兄さん/おにいさん and 従兄弟/いとこ correctly irregular — にい is not among this entry's readings and いとこ is 熟字訓.
姉: 姉妹/しまい appears under シ for 姉 and under マイ for 妹 — both halves independently correct. お姉さん/おねえさん and 従姉妹/いとこ correctly irregular.
寒: the same headword 寒気 sits under さむ.い as さむけ and under カン as かんき — two real words, each filed by its own kana. Correct.
決: 決まり/きまり is under き.まる, not き.める — り is the stem of まる, so the shared span き is resolved by the right okurigana.
表: 表す/あらわす is under あらわ.す, not あら.わす (which would require the spelling 表わす). Correct slot among shared spans.
戦: 戦い/たたかい under たたか.う (い = stem of う). 連: 連れ/つれ under つ.れる (れ = stem), not -づ.れ, since the word is word-initial and undakuten.
通: とお.り takes 通り/とおり and -どお.り takes 通り/どおり — hyphen positions and rendaku both handled correctly.
相: あい- (word-initial variant) takes 相手/あいて and 相変わらず/あいかわらず; ソウ and ショウ split correctly (首相/しゅしょう vs 相談/そうだん); 相撲/すもう correctly irregular.
実: 実際/じっさい, 実行/じっこう, 実験/じっけん all 促音便 of ジツ — correctly credited to ジツ, not to a phantom ジッ slot.
表: 発表/はっぴょう — handakuten ぴょう correctly credited to ヒョウ.
部: 部屋/へや and 倶楽部/クラブ correctly irregular (熟字訓 and loanword ateji). The pre-alignment file had 倶楽部 under ブ; the rewrite is the better call here.
回: 上回る/うわまわる correctly under まわ.る (上 takes うわ, 回 takes まわ).
関: にも関わらず/にもかかわらず and 関わる/かかわる under かか.わる; 交通機関/こうつうきかん and 玄関/げんかん under カン. Correct.
最: 最早/もはや correctly irregular — も is not a kun span of 最 (もっと.も cannot yield も alone).
菜: お菜/おかず correctly irregular (gikun, not な).
